items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Dizzy, Dave Burns, John Brown, James Moody, Milt Jackson, Hank Jones…

ctx.x: Then in 1947, Ray Brown and the Be bop boys is what I have. Dizzy, Dave Burns, John Brown, James Moody, Milt Jackson, Hank Jones…
I don't know how they got all those people in Rudy Van Gelder’s studio
